niches.name: Hair salons and barbershops
niches.customers: Many; the national hairdressers' and beauticians' guild grew by 1,040 crafts (+10.7%) in 2025. Easy to list from Fresha/Zoyya directories and Instagram
niches.admin_problems: Phone bookings while cutting hair, no-shows, last-minute gaps
niches.repetitive_time: unknown: measure in interviews (minutes per day on calls/DMs)
niches.software: Fresha, Booksy, Zoyya (Croatian), Treatwell: cheap or free booking with reminders
niches.automation: Yes: online booking and reminders are standard; Treatwell launched an AI receptionist in Sept 2026
niches.willingness_to_pay: Anchors only: Fresha $19.95/month solo, Booksy GBP 40/month, AI receptionists EUR 59-199 (vendor listings)
niches.difficulty: Low to build, but the booking platforms own the calendar; little open API access (assumption)
niches.competition: Very high: platforms bundle what we would sell
niches.acquisition: Easy to reach in person, hard to sell: most already have a tool

niches.name: Beauty salons (nails, lashes, cosmetics)
niches.customers: Many; same guild and directories as hair salons
niches.admin_problems: Long appointments, deposits against no-shows, DMs with photos
niches.inquiries: Price of a treatment, availability, aftercare questions
niches.repetitive_time: unknown: measure in interviews (minutes per day on calls/DMs)
niches.software: Same platforms as hair salons (Fresha, Booksy, Zoyya, Treatwell)
niches.gdpr: Low to medium: skin conditions or allergies can be health data
niches.difficulty: Low to build; platform lock-in as above

niches.name: Dental clinics
niches.customers: Hundreds of private practices in Zagreb (estimate); reception staff act as gatekeepers
niches.admin_problems: Phone-heavy reception, recall reminders, treatment quotes, dental-tourism inquiries in English
niches.inquiries: Pain/emergency slots, prices of implants or crowns, HZZO coverage
niches.repetitive_time: unknown: measure in interviews (minutes per day on calls/DMs)
niches.software: Practice-management systems with patient records; HZZO-contracted practices also use the national eHealth system
niches.automation: Some (SMS reminders in practice software); depth unknown
niches.willingness_to_pay: Higher value per patient; no public evidence of what clinics pay for add-ons
niches.gdpr: High: health data is a special category (GDPR Art. 9); excluded from the first MVP
niches.difficulty: High: integration with clinical systems and strict data handling

niches.name: Private medical practices
niches.customers: Many polyclinics and specialist practices; gatekept
niches.inquiries: Which specialist, waiting time, price lists, referral rules
niches.repetitive_time: unknown: measure in interviews (minutes per day on calls/DMs)
niches.software: Medical practice systems; national eHealth for HZZO work
niches.automation: Some reminders; triage must stay human
niches.gdpr: Very high: health data, possible medical-device rules if it gives advice

niches.name: Gyms and fitness studios
niches.customers: Dozens to low hundreds in Zagreb (estimate); active on Instagram
niches.admin_problems: Trial sign-ups not followed up, class booking, membership renewals
niches.inquiries: Prices, trial session, class timetable, personal trainer availability
niches.repetitive_time: unknown: measure in interviews (minutes per day on calls/DMs)
niches.software: Gym-management and class-booking apps (international and local)
niches.automation: Common for class booking and payments
niches.willingness_to_pay: Unknown; lead follow-up has clear value per new member
niches.gdpr: Low to medium (health questionnaires are health data)

niches.name: Car detailing
niches.customers: Dozens in the Zagreb area (estimate; the prospect scan counts them). Most show prices, Instagram and WhatsApp publicly
niches.admin_problems: Owner is hands-on and cannot answer while working; every quote depends on car size and condition; multi-hour jobs block the bay
niches.inquiries: Price of polishing or ceramic coating for my car, free days, how long it takes
niches.repetitive_time: unknown: measure in interviews (minutes per day on calls/DMs)
niches.software: Mostly phone, WhatsApp, Instagram and contact forms (to confirm in the prospect scan)
niches.willingness_to_pay: Unknown. Job values on public price lists are high enough that one recovered job a month could cover a EUR 50-100 fee (to test)
niches.difficulty: Medium: price ranges, multi-hour slots, one resource (bay)
niches.competition: Low to medium locally; generic tools exist but are not tailored
niches.acquisition: Medium: owners are busy, but reachable on Instagram or in person; small market per city

niches.name: Real-estate agencies
niches.customers: Hundreds of agencies in Zagreb (estimate); listed on portals
niches.admin_problems: Many portal inquiries, slow replies, scheduling viewings, unqualified leads
niches.inquiries: Is it still available, viewing times, price negotiation, financing
niches.repetitive_time: unknown: measure in interviews (minutes per day on calls/DMs)
niches.willingness_to_pay: Unknown; one sale is worth thousands in commission
niches.gdpr: Medium: buyers' financial situation and identity documents

niches.name: Hotels and accommodation
niches.customers: Hundreds of private apartments in Zagreb, many more on the coast (no official Zagreb count found)
niches.admin_problems: Repeated guest questions, check-in instructions, guest registration, reviews
niches.inquiries: Parking, check-in time, Wi-Fi, directions, late arrival
niches.repetitive_time: unknown: measure in interviews (minutes per day on calls/DMs)
niches.software: Channel managers and property systems with automated messaging (e.g. Rentlio, Croatian; Smoobu)
niches.gdpr: Medium: guest identity documents for registration

niches.name: Restaurants
niches.admin_problems: Reservation calls at peak times, group bookings, menu questions
niches.inquiries: Table tonight, group menu, opening hours, allergens
niches.repetitive_time: unknown: measure in interviews (minutes per day on calls/DMs)
niches.willingness_to_pay: Low margins; anchored by reservation platforms
niches.gdpr: Low (allergen questions can touch health data)
niches.difficulty: Medium: table logic, high message volume
niches.acquisition: Medium: owners busy at service times

niches.name: Cleaning companies
niches.customers: Dozens of small firms in Zagreb (estimate); most advertise a phone, WhatsApp or form
niches.admin_problems: Every job needs a quote (m2, type, extras); staff scheduling; repeat customers rebook by phone
niches.inquiries: Price for a 70 m2 deep clean, after-renovation cleaning, regular weekly cleaning, free dates
niches.repetitive_time: unknown: measure in interviews (minutes per day on calls/DMs)
niches.software: Mostly phone and messaging (to confirm); field-service tools such as Jobber exist (reported at about $29-199/month)
niches.willingness_to_pay: Unknown; regular customers are worth a lot over a year (to test)
niches.gdpr: Low to medium: home addresses, key or access details
niches.difficulty: Medium: quote rules, team as the resource, travel time

niches.name: Law firms
niches.admin_problems: Intake of new matters, conflict checks, scheduling consultations
niches.inquiries: Can you take my case, consultation price, urgency
niches.repetitive_time: unknown: measure in interviews (minutes per day on calls/DMs)
niches.gdpr: Very high: confidential and often sensitive data; professional secrecy
niches.acquisition: Very hard for a new 18-year-old supplier

niches.name: Accounting firms
niches.customers: Many small bookkeeping services in Zagreb (estimate)
niches.admin_problems: Chasing clients for documents every month, onboarding, deadline reminders; e-invoicing changes (Fiskalizacija 2.0) in 2026-2027
niches.inquiries: Did you get my invoices, what do I need to send, deadlines
niches.repetitive_time: unknown: measure in interviews (minutes per day on calls/DMs)
niches.gdpr: High: clients' financial data (the brief excludes financial data from the first MVP)
niches.difficulty: High: document processing must be accurate

niches.name: E-commerce shops
niches.customers: Many, reachable online; not tied to Zagreb
niches.admin_problems: Order status questions, returns, product questions, abandoned carts
niches.inquiries: Where is my order, return policy, size or stock questions
niches.repetitive_time: unknown: measure in interviews (minutes per day on calls/DMs)
niches.software: Shop platforms with app stores full of AI support tools
niches.acquisition: Hard: competing with global SaaS marketing

niches.name: Tutors and education
niches.customers: Many individuals and small schools; seasonal around exams
niches.admin_problems: Scheduling lessons, payment reminders, parents' questions
niches.inquiries: Free slots, price per hour, subjects, online or in person
niches.repetitive_time: unknown: measure in interviews (minutes per day on calls/DMs)

niches.name: Small service companies and trades
niches.customers: Many plumbers, electricians, HVAC and appliance-repair firms; less active online
niches.admin_problems: Missed calls while on a job, quotes, scheduling site visits around travel
niches.inquiries: Can you come today, price for a boiler service, emergency call-out
niches.repetitive_time: unknown: measure in interviews (minutes per day on calls/DMs)
niches.software: Phone and paper; some field-service apps
niches.willingness_to_pay: Unknown; one missed job is worth EUR 50-300 (estimate)
niches.acquisition: Medium to hard: owners are on site and less online
